citation: ASABE. 2005 (R2024). ASAE D384.2 MAR2005: Manure Production and Characteristics. Section 9, as-excreted manure equations for swine (9.3 grow-finish, 9.4 weanling, 9.5 gestating sow, 9.6 lactating sow) and Tables 15-18 defaults. Equations implemented in data/scripts/build_excretion.py; standard text is not reproduced in this repository.
license: copyrighted ASABE standard; used as a method by project exception (Mahmoud 2026-10-18)

citation: ASAE D384.2 Tables 1-2, typical as-excreted swine manure values (nursery, grow-finish per finished animal; gestating and lactating sow per animal-day), as reproduced by the Livestock and Poultry Environmental Learning Community. Used for K and VS/TS (no swine equations) and as a sanity check.
Project assumption where no open 2022 value was found: fat-free lean 53% at market weight, born-alive piglet birth weight 1.4 kg. Flagged for replacement.

IPCC. 2006. Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol. 4 Ch. 10, Tier 2 N excretion: N excreted = N intake x (1 - N retention fraction), swine retention fraction 0.30 (Table 10.20). Sanity check only.
